tests.name: decision-preview absence and composer/dock hit tests

manual.reason: The completion/unique-count behaviour has no named automated test in this batch; the read-only projection is asserted only by the browser harness under tests/mobile-decision-preview-occlusion.spec.mjs, which covers layout, not counting.
manual.steps: Open the decision-card surface with one completed and one pending todo row and read the entry count; then complete the pending row and read the count again.
manual.expected: Only visible, undecided unique ids are counted; the completed row stays listed but stops being counted.
